# Git workflow skill

Use this skill when preparing or validating work on the current feature branch.

Guidelines:
- Check `git status` before starting and again before finishing work.
- Keep changes focused on the current task and avoid unrelated edits.
- Work safely on the active feature branch instead of modifying unrelated branches or shared history.
- Do not commit or push unless explicitly instructed to do so.
- Review the changed files before concluding work to confirm the patch matches the request.

This skill is intended to keep branch work clean, reviewable, and limited to the task at hand.
